mentions.name: bewCloud
mentions.description: A simpler Nextcloud alternative written in TypeScript that has reached feature freeze; ongoing maintenance and updates with a focus on removing dependencies, and currently awaiting a security audit.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building bewCloud [1] (a simpler Nextcloud alternative written in TypeScript) over the last couple of years and it's finally reached "feature freeze"; I don't plan to add anything major to it anymore, and will now keep maintaining it, updating it, and will focus on removing dependencies. I'm currently waiting for a security audit.

mentions.name: bewCloud
mentions.description: A self-hosted cloud platform built with TypeScript, Deno, and Fresh, offering a simpler alternative to Nextcloud and ownCloud. It recently added a CalDAV and CardDAV server, with calendar and contacts UI planned as next features. Development is sponsored by NLnet.
mentions.problem: Existing self-hosted cloud solutions like Nextcloud and ownCloud are complex; there is a need for a simpler alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on bewCloud [1] after getting a decent sponsor(ship) earlier this year from NLnet.

It's a simpler alternative to Nextcloud and ownCloud (built with TypeScript, Deno, Fresh). Recently it got a CalDAV and CardDAV server, and I'll be working on the calendar and contacts UI next.
